security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown tutorials and code-fence markers, not executable skill logic. The confirmed issues are unsafe file upload examples, plus semantic findings for unsafe download path handling and wildcard production host configuration. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Sanitize uploaded filenames, generate server-side names, normalize paths against a fixed upload directory, and reject traversal attempts.
Resolve requested files against a fixed upload directory and reject any normalized path that escapes that directory.

remediation.issue: Wildcard host allowlist in production guidance
remediation.suggestion: Replace allowed_hosts = ["*"] with explicit hostnames and show environment-specific host configuration.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe File Download Path Handling
semantic_findings.description: The download example constructs the file path directly from a route parameter and returns it with FileResponse. If copied as-is, this can allow path traversal outside the uploads directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The route parameter filename flows directly into a filesystem path and FileResponse without normalization or containment checks.

semantic_findings.title: Wildcard Host Allowlist in Production Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The production configuration example sets allowed_hosts to a wildcard. If copied to production, this weakens host-header controls and should use explicit hostnames.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setting appears under a Production Configuration heading and uses a wildcard host list, which is risky guidance despite being documentation.

content.value_statement: FastAPI projects need consistent patterns for routes, validation, authentication, storage, and deployment. This skill provides progressive reference guides for building and reviewing API features.
actual_capabilities: Guides basic FastAPI app setup, routing, parameters, response models, and status codes.
Provides Pydantic validation, error handling, and CRUD endpoint patterns.
Covers JWT, OAuth2, dependency injection, middleware, CORS, and background tasks.
Explains SQLAlchemy and async database integration patterns for API services.
Includes WebSocket, testing, Docker, Gunicorn, Kubernetes, and deployment examples.
limitations: Examples are instructional and require project-specific security review before production use.
The skill does not run tests or inspect services unless the host agent has tools.
Placeholder credentials and URLs must be replaced with secure environment-specific values.
It does not replace compliance review for regulated data or authentication systems.

use_cases.title: Create a First API
use_cases.description: Plan routes, request models, response models, and errors for a new FastAPI service.

use_cases.title: Add Auth and Persistence
use_cases.description: Design JWT login, protected routes, SQLAlchemy models, and database session patterns.

use_cases.title: Prepare Deployment Patterns
use_cases.description: Review tests, Docker packaging, worker settings, health checks, and Kubernetes deployment examples.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic API
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fastapi-mastery to create a simple FastAPI service for [resource]. Include routes, request fields, response fields, and error cases.

prompt_templates.title: Add Validation and Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fastapi-mastery to improve this FastAPI endpoint with Pydantic validation, response models, status codes, and clear HTTPException handling.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Auth and Database
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fastapi-mastery to design JWT authentication, protected dependencies, SQLAlchemy models, and CRUD operations for [application feature].

prompt_templates.title: Review Deployment Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fastapi-mastery to review this FastAPI project for testing, Docker deployment, worker configuration, health checks, logging, and production settings.

output_examples.input: Create CRUD endpoints for products with validation.
output_examples.output: A route plan with request models, response models, status codes, validation rules, and not-found error handling.

output_examples.input: Add JWT authentication to an existing FastAPI app.
output_examples.output: An implementation outline for token creation, password hashing, current-user dependencies, and protected routes.

output_examples.input: Prepare my service for container deployment.
output_examples.output: A deployment checklist covering Docker packaging, environment settings, health checks, worker process settings, and tests.

best_practices: Start with typed Pydantic models for every request and response contract.
Keep authentication, database sessions, and shared services behind FastAPI dependencies.
Review file handling, secrets, CORS, and host settings before production deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder secrets, database URLs, or permissive host settings into production.
Do not trust uploaded filenames or route parameters when reading or writing files.
Do not skip tests for authentication, database access, validation, and deployment health checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build FastAPI services with routes, validation, authentication, databases, tests, and deployment patterns.

faq.question: Does it cover authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes JWT, OAuth2 password flow, password hashing, current-user dependencies, and protected routes.

faq.question: Does it support database work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers SQLAlchemy sessions, async database access, models, relationships, and CRUD operations.

faq.question: Can it help with deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Docker, Gunicorn, Kubernetes, health checks, logging, and configuration examples.

faq.question: Is the generated code production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat examples as starting points and review security settings, secrets, file handling, and tests.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
